# AGLAYA — The Uncomfortable Agency

> AGLAYA is a trilingual (EN/ES/PT) AI-powered automation agency for digital businesses.
> We build operational systems — not campaigns. Clients own everything we build.

## About

AGLAYA installs high-performance AI automation infrastructure: lead qualification flows,
custom CRM logic, automated reporting, content pipelines, and full-stack digital systems.
We operate across English, Spanish, and Portuguese markets.

Taglines:
- EN: "The Uncomfortable AI·gency"
- ES: "La Agenc·IA Incómoda"
- PT: "A Agência Desconfortável"
